attempts.summary: Deployed a stdlib-Python inventory web app (port 8080) as a systemd service on node2 and node3, and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on port 80 (round-robin over both backends). Verified load distribution, failover, and recovery. Then executed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes, proving boot-identity change and full service/data recovery after each restart, ending with a healthy, load-balanced cluster.
